text: An order is placed by exactly one customer and contains one or more line items. Each line item references a product by SKU and records the unit price at the time of sale. Loyalty-tier discount is applied based on the customer's tier at order time, not at shipment time.

A promotion is identified by a promo code. A promotion has a type (percentage, fixed-dollar, loyalty-tier-linked) and an exclusivity flag. Two promotions may stack only if neither is marked exclusive and their type combination satisfies the stacking matrix.

A product family groups SKUs that differ by color or size. Return policy applies to the product family, not the SKU - a size exchange within the family is always permitted even after the standard return window if the item is unworn.
